commit.subject: LU-20247 tests: ignore errors from fstrim
commit.message:
LU-20247 tests: ignore errors from fstrim

this is just an optimization to save space in /tmp. on zfs fstrim
is asynchronous and a subsequent try to trim fs can fail.

Fixes: 6872cf9a36 ("LU-17722 tests: trim tmpfs from wait_delete_completed()")
